QF.id: VIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_50

question.text: Bank Nifty futures are trading at 52,400 with a lot size of 15. What is the contract value of one Bank Nifty futures contract?

explanation.text: The Logic: Step-by-step calculation: Contract Value = Futures Price x Lot Size = 52,400 x 15 = Rs. 7,86,000 The Trap: Rs. 52,400 is the price per unit, not the contract value. Rs. 78,60,000 adds an extra zero. Rs. 3,49,333 incorrectly divides instead of multiplying. Cross-Exam Context: Bank Nifty contract values are commonly used in Series VIII exam questions. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Contract Value = Price x Lot Size. Bank Nifty: 52,400 x 15 = Rs. 7,86,000.
